title: Improvement in Food Resources
seo_title: Improvement in Food Resources Class 9 Science Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 12)
standard_code: Class 9, Chapter 12: Improvement in Food Resources
standard_text: Plant and animal breeding and selection for quality improvement and management; use of fertilizers and manures; protection from pests and diseases; organic farming.
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 9 Science worksheets for NCERT Chapter 12: kharif and rabi crops, crop variety improvement, nutrients, manures and fertilisers, cropping patterns, crop protection, and animal husbandry: cattle, poultry, fish and bees. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Better seeds, good care and protection raise food production.
key_sub: Kharif crops grow in the rainy season; rabi crops in winter.
body_html:
How to think about it

Food production is raised by improving crop varieties (hybridisation for yield, quality and disease resistance), managing crops (nutrients, manures and fertilisers, irrigation and cropping patterns such as mixed cropping, intercropping and crop rotation) and protecting crops from weeds, pests, diseases and damage in storage.

Animal husbandry looks after dairy animals, poultry, fish and bees. Exotic and Indian breeds are crossed to combine high yield with disease resistance; composite fish culture keeps species that feed at different levels in one pond.

Example

Is wheat a kharif or rabi crop?

sown in winter

Answer: rabi

Example

Which fish feeds at the bottom in composite culture?

catla surface, rohu middle

Answer: mrigal (or common carp)

Common mistakes

  • Calling paddy a rabi crop.
  • Thinking fertilisers improve soil structure like manure.
  • Mixing up mixed cropping and intercropping.

faq.a: Manure is natural organic matter that improves soil structure; fertilisers are factory-made chemicals that give specific nutrients quickly.
